marks.law: occlusion vocabulary only — every mark is a recess, so every mark is darker and none has a lit side. Minimum extent derived from the device gate: 1px is readable if long (the cracks), a blob is not (the retired 4px overlay marks).

crack.law: field scale, minimum readable extent as a refusal, no taper and no feather. Replaces a per-tile overlay whose median mark was 4px.

classes.0: joint — offset is defined zero, never remapped

law: ruling (1): stone value assigned at the stone from a shared address, so the tile boundary has no special status. ruling (2): course-aligned families, ashlar bond as family structure. §8.3.1 continuity test governs the coursing: bed joints travel and the boundary course is indistinguishable from the mid-tile course.
atlas_encoding: 6x6 of 32px; cell = split*9 + drop0*3 + drop1, row-major. R = index into ladder, G = stone class 0..6

differential.law: one scalar sampled by world position drives joint opening, chipping, dressing amplitude and the traffic bias. Periods 5 and 11 tiles: coprime with each other and with the tile, so nothing lands on the grid.

wear.law: every term is a subtraction; §8.2.1 forbids signalling polish by brightness, so nothing is added anywhere

what: LOOP-PROCESS §4's plant: the SAME bond, courses, merges, palette, grain bank and stone addressing as the candidate, with picturesque ruin baked into the bond so it goes through the identical engine painter. Never lands, never shown to Rafe. If the seat does not catch it, the round is VOID.

paint_check.what: finished RGB from the shipped path. The engine reproduces every one of these or refuses to lay the floor. Covers joints, plain stone, trodden stone, joints beside trodden stone, and spanning stones seen from both sides.

fallback_tile.why: magenta; a painter failure must go red
